description: Authenticated user profile page for IDOR Eats. Displays user information, favorite restaurants, and provides access to password change functionality. Requires active session (PHPSESSID cookie).
notes: CRITICAL IDOR VULNERABILITIES: The JavaScript contains hardcoded userId (e.g., userId=13) in API calls. This allows attackers to manipulate the userId parameter to: 1) Access favorite restaurants of any other user, 2) Change password of any other user. The profile page displays userId directly in the JavaScript, making it trivial to identify and exploit.
